title: Code and data for: Resonant enhancement and source priors shape subwavelength acoustic reconstruction
description: Companion code, reduced measurements, frozen inputs, Source Data and validation for the 14 November 2026 manuscript, edition 4. Supports five main figures, eight supplementary figures, Supplementary Notes 1–16 and one supplementary table. Includes eighteen original prior-network checkpoints and complete covariance-analysis inputs. Forty selected raw waveforms are supplied; other raw time series are excluded. See README.md and REPRODUCTION_REPORT.json for scope and validation.
